app_subtitle: Small AI for Noor's farm tours
loading_models: Loading the small models onto this phone…
models_ready: Models ready on this phone ({kb} KB). Works offline.
models_failed: Could not load the models. Open the app once while online so they are saved on this phone.
inbox_help: Paste a message from WhatsApp, SMS or email. The tool tells you what the visitor wants and drafts a reply. You decide what is sent.
inbox_placeholder: e.g. Hi! How much is the coffee tour for 2 adults on Saturday?
unsure_title: Not sure. Please read it yourself.
reply_meaning: What this says, in your language
copy_send_own: Copy my reply & mark as sent
copied: Copied to clipboard. Paste it into WhatsApp or SMS.
human_in_loop: This tool suggests. You decide. Nothing is sent without you.
bookings_help: Keep track of who is coming. Confirmation and reminder messages are fixed templates in the visitor's language.
feedback_help: Paste a review or a thank-you message. The tool splits it into parts and tags what each part is about and whether it is praise or a complaint. Parts it is unsure about are shown as unsure, never guessed.
feedback_placeholder: e.g. The coffee tasting was the highlight, but the road up was terrible…
coverage: {confident} of {total} parts were clear enough to count. {unsure} skipped as unsure.
listing_help: Every reply and message is filled from these facts. Keep them up to date. The listing text below is built from them only, ready to paste into a booking site, WhatsApp Business or a printed sign.
sms_help: Noor's own phone only does calls and SMS. The same models run on a small box at the cooperative: a visitor texts the farm number, Noor gets one Kiswahili SMS telling her what they want, and replies 1, 2 or in her own words. This page simulates that flow against the backend.
sms_offline: The SMS channel runs on the edge box / server, so this page needs a connection to it.
sms_operator_text: Noor's reply (1, 2 or your own words)
about_what: Karibu helps Noor, a smallholder coffee farmer who hosts a few visitors a month, run her tours as a small business: understand enquiries in languages she does not read, answer them with messages she approves, keep bookings, and learn what visitors liked and did not.
about_rules: The brief's rules, and how we meet them
rule_device: Runs on a device the user already has: SMS for Noor's basic phone; this web app for the weekend smartphone, no app store.
rule_offline: Core feature works offline: the models and templates are saved on the phone on first load. Reading messages and feedback never needs a signal.
rule_small: Small model files: four JSON models, about {kb} KB in total, side-loadable over 3G.
rule_language: Local language: Noor's side is Kiswahili (demo language). Visitors are answered in English, French or Kiswahili. Other languages are flagged, not guessed.
guard_1: A person makes the final call. Nothing is sent to a visitor until Noor presses a button or replies by SMS.
guard_2: Below {pct}% confidence the tool says it is not sure and shows no suggestion.
guard_3: Every visitor-facing sentence comes from a fixed template list. The tool cannot invent facts about the farm.
guard_4: Each answer shows its confidence and the full list of scores, so a wrong guess is visible, not hidden.
about_models_note: Accuracy is on a held-out split of our own synthetic seed data (see METRICS.md). 'Answers' is the share of inputs the tool answers at all; the rest become 'not sure'. Real visitor messages will be messier; expect lower numbers until the models are tuned on real traffic.
about_data: Data sources and what they do not cover
about_data_offline: Connect once to load the dataset list from the backend.
data_1: Visitor messages, phone numbers and feedback are stored on this phone and, when a signal is available, on the cooperative's box. No third-party cloud is required.
data_2: The models are trained offline on synthetic data; nothing a visitor writes is used to train anything.
data_3: Shared or lost phone: this app stores only business messages, no payments or IDs. Clearing the browser data removes everything.
about_localising: What localising AI development means to us
localising_text: Not a bigger model that happens to speak Swahili, but a small one shaped by Noor's constraints: her phone, her signal, her language, her right to decide. The AI reads; Noor answers.
queued: {n} record(s) saved on this phone, waiting for signal
synced: Sent {n} record(s) to the cooperative box.
